An attempt left with neither (the measure process dies or errors after the child measure ends but before FAULT or DONE is written, e.g. a crash on a ledger append) is re-scored and its RETRIEVAL line printed, though it was never judged whole. Should: refuse with MS-KEPT unless DONE exists. Ordinary work: no, because it needs a crash in the gap between the child's end and the marker write. Consequence: other (a figure is printed but nothing counts it: COUNTS is absent and judge refuses with MS-NOCOUNT). Reversed by: a run showing an attempt with neither marker can only come from a hand edit, or a fix requiring DONE (one line plus one test).
```
- F-2 | minor (out of scope: governance/project/path-map.yaml is not in allowed_paths; Interface items 3 and 9 put these files under runs/<A>/) | F1 | governance/project/path-map.yaml:598-602 | The guard's sets_root_hidden hides runs/*/misses.jsonl but not runs/<audit>/reader/** (answers, cited paths) or runs/<audit>/{attempt,control}-*/kept/**, pool/kept/** (the hidden questions' bundles). An orchestrator or lead opening runs/memory-audit-<date>/reader/<id>.json to diagnose a stop is refused nothing; the fresh 80 hid runs/fresh-80/** for this. Ordinary work: yes, because reading a run folder is ordinary diagnosis. Consequence: other (held-out content reaches a measured role; no figure is wrong). Reversed by: a guard test showing these paths already refused, or an owner ruling that audit run rows need no guard.
```
